name: Tempest Domain
summary: Clerics of storm gods who strike with thunder and lightning.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.short: Extra spells that are always prepared.
features.summary: You always have your domain spells prepared once you reach the listed cleric levels. They don't count against the number of spells you prepare each day.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.summary: You gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: Wrath of the Storm
features.short: Reaction: blast an attacker for 2d8 lightning or thunder.
features.summary: When a creature within 5 ft. hits you, you can use your reaction to make it make a DEX save, taking 2d8 lightning or thunder damage on a failure, half on a success. Uses: WIS modifier per long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath
features.summary: When you roll lightning or thunder damage, you can use Channel Divinity to deal maximum damage instead of rolling.

features.name: Thunderous Strike
features.short: Lightning damage pushes Large or smaller creatures 10 ft.
features.summary: When you deal lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature, you can also push it up to 10 ft. away from you.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.short: Once per turn, weapon hits deal +1d8 thunder (2d8 at 14th).
features.summary: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 thunder damage. At 14th level the extra damage becomes 2d8.

features.name: Stormborn
features.short: Fly at your walking speed outdoors.
features.summary: You have a flying speed equal to your current walking speed whenever you are not underground or indoors.
